title: Low-Cal Coronation Tofu Salad
subtitle: with Quinoa and Curry Dressing
description: We've given this retro classic a vego twist. Keeping the calories low with tofu, quinoa and crisp veggies, the jewel in the crown is the signature curry dressing, balanced with sweet raisins. It's a meal fit for a king or queen!

steps.text: Cook quinoa: Put half the quinoa in a sieve, then rinse well and drain (see Kitchen 101). Put in a small saucepan with 125ml (½ cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 12-15 mins until the water is absorbed and the quinoa is tender. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for 5 mins.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, separate the lettuce into leaves, then thinly slice half of them. Cut the tofu into 1cm cubes. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater. Finely grate the zest of half the lime, then juice the half. Cut the remaining half into wedges.
Warm tofu: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 1-2 mins each side until golden and warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat.

Make dressing: Put the lime juice and zest, 1 tsp curry powder, 2 tbs mayonnaise, 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp water in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the tofu, quinoa, sliced lettuce, carrot and raisins and toss to combine.
Serve up: Divide the whole lettuce leaves among bowls, then top with the tofu salad. Serve with the lime wedges for squeezing over. Enjoy!

Kitchen 101: It’s important to rinse the quinoa well to remove the natural coating called saponin, which can make it taste bitter or soapy. And as this is a low-calorie dish, we recommend using only half of the quinoa. If you wish to use it all, simply double the dressing – the dish will still taste delicious!
